packing: Arrays in flexion × adduction × rotation order, rotation varies fastest. Coordinates are positive for flexion, adduction and internal rotation, other coordinates held at defaults.
effectiveArmDefinition: Negative of the signed adduction moment arm, averaged over three medius and three minimus segments with weights proportional to maximum isometric force. This is a recruitment assumption. Distances are metres.

referencePaths.frame: Neutral right femur frame with origin at hip joint center, metres. +X anterior, +Y superior, +Z lateral (right). Other coordinates at model defaults. Nodes follow their named body; display on an independent atlas requires registration. OpenSim computes path wrapping anew at each pose.

itb.description: Medial guide reaction in newtons per newton total tension across the three ITB sub-tracts. Tension is distributed by maximum isometric force. At each named trochanteric via point sum the two adjacent unit tensions in the femur frame and retain the positive inward component along -Z. This regional proxy assumes frictionless redirection and a lateral reference surface. Actual tendon contact, bursa pressure and symptoms require additional measurements.

workedExample.interpretation: MRI-personalized vs generic-scaled at identical coordinates in one worked example. Force ratio assumes the six segments alone balance an equal imposed abduction moment and share tension in proportion to model maximum isometric force.
